These intermediates all ultimately target Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1, indicating a potential pathway through multiple molecular interactions. The scores from the paths suggest a consistent and significant relationship, though the exact mechanism of action remains unclear. The evidence points to a possible role of the transporter family member 1B1 in mediating the effects of these compounds, possibly through the transport of anions or other molecules. The integration of these pathways highlights the importance of this transporter in the biological response to Methylpentynol and its related compounds.
